features.title: Message tags
features.explanation: The server offers message-tags: Boson gets message IDs, timestamps and client tags from it.

features.title: Echo of sent messages
features.explanation: The server offers echo-message: Boson sees its own messages as the server delivered them.

features.title: Server timestamps
features.explanation: The server offers server-time: every message carries the time the server saw it.

features.title: Chat history
features.explanation: The server has no CHATHISTORY. evrd logs the channels and private messages of Boson users and serves history from that log, so history starts when Boson first joins a channel. (InspIRCd's chanhistory module only replays recent lines on join; it has no CHATHISTORY command.)
features.fix: InspIRCd 4 has no module for this; Ergo and UnrealIRCd 6 provide it natively.

features.title: Read markers
features.explanation: The server has no draft/read-marker. evrd keeps each account's read markers and syncs them between that user's Boson devices.
features.fix: InspIRCd 4 has no module for this; Ergo provides it natively.

features.title: Replies
features.explanation: The server relays +draft/reply (message-tags, not in CLIENTTAGDENY): it reaches everyone with an IRCv3 client.

features.title: Reactions
features.explanation: The server relays +draft/react (message-tags, not in CLIENTTAGDENY): it reaches everyone with an IRCv3 client.

features.title: Deleting messages
features.explanation: The server has no draft/message-redaction. Deleting has to reach every user's client, which only the server can do; Boson hides Delete.
features.fix: InspIRCd 4 has no module for this; Ergo provides it natively.

features.title: SASL login
features.explanation: The server offers SASL (PLAIN, AUTHCOOKIE): Boson logs users in before they join anything.

features.title: Existing accounts (services RPC)
features.explanation: The Atheme RPC endpoint accepted the test account: Boson can log users in with their existing NickServ accounts.

features.title: Real user IPs (WEBIRC)
features.explanation: The server accepted WEBIRC with the given password: it sees each Boson user's real IP, so bans work per user.

features.title: Multiline messages
features.explanation: The server has no draft/multiline. A pasted block goes out as separate lines (evrd and Boson split it), and everyone sees separate lines: keeping it one message needs the server.
features.fix: InspIRCd 4 has no module for this; Ergo and UnrealIRCd 6 provide it natively.
